description.text: Education Objectives Thiscourse aims to prepare students for careers requiring global business awareness and to develop skills required to work in internationally operating companies and organizations. It provides the students with many opportunities, both to apply the theoretical knowledge acquired during the modules, and to develop a more in-depth understanding of common problems emerging in an international business environment. It is especially suitable for those students interested in international trade, international business and management, international human resource management and marketing. Main Courses Fundamentals of College Computer Science, Mathematics far Business, Introduction to Business Administration, Chinese Society and Culture, Applied Statistics,Fundamentals of Management, Microeconomics, Management Decisions Methods, Strategic Management, Production and Operations Management, Project Management, E-commerce,Marketing, Technical Economics, Market Research and Forecast, Organizational Behavior, Management Communication, Financial Management, Global Market and International Business, Analysis of New Markets and Investment Environment. Advantages of school ●Specialties There are 149 academics in the School including 1 academician of the China Engineering Academy, 1 Cheung Kong Scholar professor, 41 professors, 82 associate professors, 7 New Century talents bestowed by the Ministry of Education, 42 doctoral advisors and 1 winner of the National Science Fund for Outstanding Young Scholars.There are 9 undergraduate specialties among which 6 are key specialties of Heilongjiang Province, i.e. Information Management and Information System, Engineering Management, Finance, International Economics and Business, Business Administration and Accounting. Information Management and Information System discipline was approved as the key specialty of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. ● International Cooperation The School actively develops international exchanges and cooperation. Close academic exchanges and cooperation have been made with over 20 world famous universities including Oxford University, Cambridge University, Purdue University, the University of Arizona, University of Birmingham, Carnegie Mellon University, the National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Curtin University, Australia, and so on. Students can exchanges studies with their credits paints mutually recognized by both universities. Laboratory equipment and supply(click the pics to enlarge) Laboratory equipment of HIT Laboratory equipment of HIT Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree Careers Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation. Now many of our students graduated are working in the multi-national companies such as Siemens and Lucent. The reason why our students are highly demanded is that they are trained by experienced experts or professors in the field of business.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.Bachelor applicants should have high school education background with good marks and under the age of 35 2.Foreign citizen holding the valid passport and in good health
